The Indian Men’s Hockey Team put up a spirited fight against England in their second Pool D clash of the FIH Hockey World Cup Belgium & Netherlands 2026, but the match ended 4–2 in England’s favour.
Harmanpreet Singh opened India’s scoring with a brilliant penalty-corner strike before Dilpreet Singh finished off a well-worked move involving Hardik Singh and Abhishek to put India ahead. But England rallied from 1-2 down for their second win of the tournament.
